change.title: Classify finalize-degraded outcomes from a read-only backend projection
change.summary: Adds a minimal secret-free read-only finalize consumer projection and makes manual one-click plus auto-boot classify normal, history, cleanup-required, and manual-recovery outcomes from structured DTO fields and actual journal/binding readback instead of promoting every non-error result to applied or Ready.

basis: the projection uses a canonical-v4 read-only loader that rejects migration and never writes config or normalizes directory or file permissions

the serialized surface is limited to consumer disposition, journal disposition, binding relation, ready-only applied profile id, selection pending, and cleanup warning state; attention and manual publish unknown
the classifier consumes structured status, recovery_status, and action fields plus actual readback; it never parses message or cleanup text for control flow
manual one-click publishes applied state only from a ready projection; attention, manual, and readback failure clear stale applied presentation and remain pending
auto-boot consumes the same Rust projection, preserves the complete original DTO, and clears stale frontend applied state on every failed or attention event and one-shot readback
focused Rust and Node regressions cover normal and history cleanup, journal-open and journal-cleared manual recovery, existing bindings, readback failure, and permission-preserving reads

synthetic classifier counterexamples cover both readable old and committed AtomicRollbackUncertain read models; the injected double-failure test separately proves an invalid uncertain outcome fails closed without repair or rewrite
the existing H1 later-listener, H2 prior-stop, H3 replay/finalize, complete 15-suite source gate, and clean-context completion review remain required before H4 source closure
H1-H3 DTO keys and finalize ordering, history restore chaining, O1 ownership, artifact, installed, live, signing, and release behavior are excluded
